technical.summary: ABT shows strong short-term bullish momentum with breakouts and overbought oscillators, but elevated RSI/Stoch levels and weak intermediate trend structure limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: ABT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 65 days present material risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity (1 small purchase vs 2 sales by junior member 68-76 days ago) with neutral market sentiment and unavailable news data provides insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at 73.68 indicates crisis-level fear, and earnings in 65 days present binary event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term technical momentum (RSI 9 overbought with rising trend, MACD bullish crossover, Supertrend bullish, dual Donchian breakouts) provides tactical entry signal with defined support at 94.1395.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis at 73.68, inverted yield curve, recession signals), overbought oscillators limiting upside (RSI 75.11, Stoch 94.43), weak intermediate trend structure (price below EMA/SMA 200), zero fundamental support, and binary earnings risk in 65 days overwhelm short-term technicals.
